# `StandardFonts`

**Kind:** enum  
**Module/package:** `models`  
**SDK:** `pdfdancer-client-typescript 3.0.1`

Standard PDF fonts that are available in all PDF readers.
These 14 fonts are guaranteed to be available without embedding.
